Question: does non-injury news the AI reads (play-caller changes, offensive-line shuffles, illness, travel/weather disruption, snap limits, kicker issues, coaching changes, motivation) carry information the spread hasn't priced when we first see it? For each logged context item with a stated direction (helps/hurts that team) about the next game: (1) line move = how far the consensus spread moved toward the side the news implies, from our last odds snapshot at or before the news to our last snapshot before kickoff; (2) cover rate of that side against the closing spread. A market that already priced the news shows a move near 0 and a cover rate near 50%. Logging only; nothing bets.
